node.statement: By node 1.1, 1 is not an eigenvalue of F'(x)=A. Thus all hypotheses of GT-granas-dugundji-thm-8.5-leray-schauder hold for the restricted coordinate map, and its conclusion (a) gives J(F,x)=J(F'(x),0)=J(A,0). Local fixed-point indices are computed in such a neighbourhood, so this is J(f,x)=J(A,0).
